name: Editorial Serif
signature: Ivory paper, oversized serif headline, hairline rules, one wine-red accent.

contrast.note: Light theme. Wine accent is safe as link text on both backgrounds. Use it sparingly: one accent moment per screen.

type.eyebrow: 0.75rem, uppercase, 0.22em tracking, muted color, followed by a 48px hairline

motion.rule: Slow reveal: headlines and photos fade up 28px over 900ms with a 120ms stagger, and nothing else moves.
use: data-parallax on the hero photo at 0.08

hero.layout: Two columns: huge serif headline and a one-sentence deck on the left, one tall portrait photo on the right with a small caption under it. Hairline rule across the top, drop cap on the first paragraph below.
hero.photo: Real portrait of the owner or a real finished job, 4:5 crop.

background: Ivory paper with 1px ink hairlines at 15% opacity between sections. No cards, no boxes: separate with whitespace and rules. Surface color is used for one pull-quote band only.

button.shape: Square corners, 52px tall, wide horizontal padding.
button.label: Body sans, weight 600, uppercase, 0.12em tracking. Secondary action is an underlined text link with an arrow.
button.hover: Underline grows from left using a scaleX transform; fill does not change.

banned: more than one accent moment per screen
